title: a bus spawned from a python outside the venv runs on the venv's interpreter
intention: windowless_spawn.background_python() answers Cairn's venv interpreter when its caller is a python outside any venv and a venv stands ($CAIRN_VENV or ~/.cairn/venv, bin/python3 then Scripts/python.exe); a caller in a venv, a box with no venv, and an explicit executable keep their answer; background_pythonw rides it.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 by akiendell_cc_0 on akiendell (Windows): from the system python, which has no psycopg2, scratch_bus.launch('codemother') died at `import psycopg2`, because background_python() returned sys.executable and remote.py's _detached/_setsid spawn every bus through it. With this change plus passfile 4b1c65ef9, the same launch from the system python served in 4.1 s.
traces_to: CP4 (builders on Windows cannot cast while the bus cannot come up); Law 7 (the spawn picks the interpreter the bus can run on, not the one that happens to call).
how: Add venv_python() mirroring recovery/bootstrap.sh cairn_python; background_python() returns sys.executable when the caller is in a venv or no venv stands, else the venv's interpreter; an explicit executable wins. A red-first proof runs a real child from the base interpreter.

clauses.claim: a real child run from the base interpreter (outside a venv) calling plain background_python() answers the venv's interpreter
a venv caller, a box with no venv, and an explicit executable each keep their answer
venv_python finds both layouts, honours $CAIRN_VENV, prefers bin/ over Scripts/, and answers None for a venv that does not stand

decisions.text: D1: venv_python() and the venv-aware background_python() in windowless_spawn.py; background_pythonw unchanged and riding it.
D2: one red-first proof, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: from the system python the scratch bus died at import psycopg2; with the change plus 4b1c65ef9 it served in 4.1 s; the new proof 0/3 on the unfixed helper, 3/3 twice by the system and by the venv python
measured.how: akiendell_cc_0 on akiendell, branch venv-spawn-interpreter @805d11a98 in a throwaway worktree, relayed by message
